sentences.latin: Nos Johannes dei gratia episcopus Basiliensis universis et singulis, quorum interest ac intererit, notificari cupimus per presentes, quod cum in monasterio Campi Regis ordinis Sancte Clare Constantiensis dyocesis personarum religiosarum magna copia habeatur ac tenuitate prebendarum eedem persone deffectu notabili pregraventur. nos attendentes, quod cum dicte persone divino cultui insudent iugiter et devote dignumque sit, ut qui deo frequenter serviunt, uberiori alimonia sustententur, pensata igitur et considerata tenuitate prebendarum et multitudine personarum predictarum pure propter deum et ut eo comodius sustentari valeant ac altissimo quietius famulari necnon contemplatione illustris et inclite domine domine Agnetis regine Ungrie ecclesiam parrochialem in Erlispach nostre Basiliensi dyodyocesi, cuius iuspatronatus ad religiosas in Christo dominas abbatissam et conventum predicti monasterii Campi Regis dinoscitur pertinere, de comuni consensu nostri capituli abbatisse et conventui suprascriptis ac mense communi ipsius monasterii presenbus incorporamus, annectimus et unimus.
sentences.english: We, John, by the grace of God Bishop of Basel, desire to make known by these presents to each and every one whom it concerns and will concern that, whereas in the monastery of Königsfelden of the Order of Saint Clare in the Diocese of Constance there is a great multitude of religious persons, and those same persons are heavily burdened by a notable deficiency due to the meagerness of their prebends: we, considering that since the said persons devote themselves continually and devoutly to divine worship and it is fitting that those who frequently serve God be sustained with more abundant nourishment, having therefore weighed and considered the meagerness of the prebends and the multitude of the aforesaid persons, purely for the sake of God and so that they may be sustained the more comfortably and serve the Most High the more peacefully, and also out of regard for the illustrious and renowned lady, Lady Agnes, Queen of Hungary, with the common consent of our chapter we hereby incorporate, annex, and unite the parish church in Erlinsbach in our Diocese of Basel—whose right of patronage is known to belong to the religious ladies in Christ, the abbess and convent of the aforesaid monastery of Königsfelden—to the above-written abbess and convent and to the common table of that monastery.

sentences.latin: volentes et tenore presencium indulgentes, ut rectore prefate ecclesie in Erlispach, qui nunc est cedente vel decedente prelibati monasterii abbatissa et conventus universos fructus, proventus, obventiones et redditus ad rectoriam eiusdem ecclesie pertinentes auctoritate propria apprehendere perpetuo valeant et suis usibus applicare.
sentences.english: We also will and grant by the tenor of these presents that, upon the resignation or death of the present rector of the aforesaid church in Erlinsbach, the abbess and convent of the aforementioned monastery may forever take possession by their own authority of all the fruits, revenues, offerings, and rents belonging to the rectory of the same church and apply them to their own uses.

sentences.latin: vicarius tamen ipsius ecclesie perpetuo nobis et nostris successoribus quotiens ipsam vicariam vacare contigerit per dominas abbatissam et conventum antedictas presentando reservata prebenda inferius annotata, ut iura episcopalia solvere valeat et alia incumbentia onera comodius supportare.
sentences.english: However, a vicar of that church shall perpetually be presented to us and our successors by the aforesaid ladies, the abbess and convent, whenever that vicarage happens to fall vacant, with the prebend noted below reserved for him, so that he may be able to pay the episcopal dues and more comfortably bear the other incumbent burdens.

sentences.latin: est autem prebenda ipsi vicario ut premittitur reservata decem modii tritici cum oblationibus et aliis obventionibus hactenus consuetis videlicet anniversariis et remediis quibuscumque cum augmento etiam de novo ratione dicte incorporationis addito eidem prebende antique videlicet novem modiorum tritici de dote ipsius ecclesie et unius maltri avene de decima eiusdem ecclesie et quatuor soͧmarum vini albi etiam de decima ipsius ecclesie singulis annis, ita tamen, quod si ratione sterilitatis aliqua anno de decima prefate ecclesie dicte quatuor soͧme vini haberi non possent, illud quod tunc ipsi vicario defficeret, sibi anno sequenti totaliter sine contradictione qualibet supleatur.
sentences.english: Now, the prebend reserved for the vicar himself as stated above is ten modii of wheat together with the offerings and other revenues hitherto customary, namely anniversaries and pious soul-offerings of whatever kind, together with an augmentation newly added to that old prebend by reason of the said incorporation, namely nine modii of wheat from the endowment of the church itself, one malter of oats from the tithe of the same church, and four saums of white wine also from the tithe of the church itself each year; provided, however, that if by reason of crop failure in any year the said four saums of wine cannot be obtained from the tithe of the aforesaid church, whatever is then lacking to the vicar shall be made up to him in full in the following year without any objection whatsoever.

sentences.latin: ita cuius incorporacionis, annexionis, unionis et augmentationis testimonium evidens atque robur sigillum nostrum pendi fecimus ad presentes et nos Thuringus de Ramstein prepositus, Waltherus de Klingen decanus totumque capitulum prefate ecclesie Basiliensis in signum nostri consensus premissis omnibus accedentis sigillum dicti nostri capituli fecimus presentibus coappendi.
sentences.english: In clear testimony and confirmation of which incorporation, annexation, union, and augmentation we have caused our seal to be hung to these presents; and we, Thüring von Ramstein, provost, Walther von Klingen, dean, and the entire chapter of the aforesaid church of Basel, as a sign of our consent given to all the foregoing, have caused the seal of our said chapter to be appended together with it to these presents.

sentences.latin: datum Basilee anno domini millesimo cccͦ quinquagesimo, feria sexta post festum beati Martini episcopi.
sentences.english: Given at Basel in the year of the Lord 1350, on the Friday after the feast of Saint Martin the Bishop.
